plain: Giving back what was taken, or paying for a loss

webster.text: The act of returning or restoring to a person some thing or right of which he has been unjustly deprived; as the restitution of ancient rights to the crown.

more.text: The act of making good, or of giving an equivalent for any loss, damage or injury; indemnification.
The act of recovering a former state or posture.

example.quote: If the public faith would admit, of which he was not clear, he would not object to a revision of the debt so far as to compel restitution to the ignorant & distressed, who have been defrauded.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 25, 1787
